Name: Usable Hay Hoppers
Author: ncarigon
Description:
I don't enjoy strange and inconsistent restrictions. Overall, this mod makes hay hoppers more versatile -- being either very small silos, or simply to enable auto-feeding. It also makes silos directly usable so you may not even need a hay hopper early on if you build a silo instead.

Primary changes include:

[list]
[*]Players can always pick up at least 1 hay from a hay hopper, even if the feed troughs are full.
[*]Players can pick up and move the hay hopper.
[*]Daily auto-feeding only works if there is a hay hopper in the coop/barn.
[/list][list]
[*]Hay hoppers each have a (configurable) 24 hay capacity, contributing to overall farm hay storage.
[*]Players can scythe hay from grass without a silo or hay hopper, in which case the hay will drop as an item.
[*]Hay can be directly taken from silos.
[*]Hay hoppers can be sold by Marnie as equipment, removing them from initial farm building data.
[*]Most settings are configurable using GMCM.
[/list]
Since the hay hoppers can now hold hay capacity directly, if you pick one up and it's lost capacity would cause your hay storage to be too high, the overflow hay will drop as an item stack.

Compatibility has not been tested with any other mods, but this should be highly compatible since only minor changes are made to base game logic.

Source: [url=https://github.com/ncarigon/StardewValleyMods]ncarigon/StardewValleyMods (github.com)[/url]
